name: support-aware-episodic-readout-on-vicreg-s14
purpose: Test whether the v9 VICReg representation is masked by a supervised episodic sampler that excludes every class with fewer than eight fold-local training rows.

single_factor.name: episodic_class_eligibility_and_scarce_class_sampling_rule
single_factor.baseline: exact v9 C1 VICReg S14 initialization followed by the strict without-replacement 20-way 3-shot 5-query plan; classes require at least 8 training rows
single_factor.candidate: the identical VICReg S14 initialization and supervised recipe, but classes with at least 2 training rows are eligible; classes with 2-7 rows use disjoint support/query pools and resampling only within each pool to retain fixed 3-shot and 5-query tensor shapes
scarce_class_algorithm: shuffle all indices of the selected class without replacement
assign min(3, n-1) distinct rows to the support pool and every remaining row to the query pool
fill support to exactly 3 and query to exactly 5 by sampling with replacement only inside the corresponding pool
never allow the same source row in both support and query for an episode
construct every support and query pool exclusively from the fold-local train split; candidate episode OOF-row exposure must remain zero
for n >= 8 preserve the historical without-replacement selection exactly
unchanged: official frozen DINOv2-S/14 base features and all five persisted v9 caches
label-free fold-local VICReg objective, views, coefficients, seed, epochs and optimizer
30 supervised epochs, 100 episodes per epoch, 20 ways, 3 support slots and 5 query slots per class
AdamW, learning rate, weight decay, temperature, schedule and gradient clipping
fold assignments, OOF rows, prototypes, metrics and 2000-replicate component bootstrap
no final-test access, runtime write, automatic promotion or parameter sweep

evaluation.primary_evidence: lower bound of the paired provenance-component cluster-bootstrap interval for support-aware candidate minus exact C1 control pooled OOF top1
descriptive_non_gating_outputs: top1 and top3 by affected versus historically supported OOF strata
per-class train support counts and OOF metrics
component-bootstrap intervals and exact McNemar result
evaluation.measurement_limitation: Only 11 classes and 25 provenance components are independently evaluable OOF; individual rows are not treated as independent evidence, stratum results are descriptive, and the candidate is never promotion-eligible.
evaluation.scarce_class_interpretation: For 2-3-row classes, repeated slots are an intentional class-balanced oversampling intervention. Their stratified result is descriptive only and cannot establish generalization beyond the few observed provenance components.
evaluation.rank_guard_interpretation: The candidate must not only avoid further collapse relative to C1 control; it must also repair the original v9 rank failure relative to persisted B0.

decision_rule.supported: all integrity and efficacy gates pass
decision_rule.neutral_or_not_supported: integrity passes but any efficacy gate fails
decision_rule.after_failure: close support-aware sampler branch and retain alpha=0.5 SSL-update interpolation as the next preregistered fallback
